description: This file defines a global exception handler in a Spring Boot web application, managing various exceptions and mapping them to appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice that handles global exceptions across controllers, providing custom error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException and returns a 404 Not Found response with an error message.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles BadRequestException and returns a 400 Bad Request response with an error message.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation-related exceptions (MethodArgumentNotValidException and BindException), extracts validation error messages, and returns a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions and returns a 500 Internal Server Error response with a generic message.
